'''Galactic City Authority''' was the government of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the time of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. They were in charge of all the public works operations and other government agencies on Coruscant and presumably collected taxes to fund other planetary organizations such as the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Police]] and [[Coruscant Fire and Rescue]]. They also had an incident command room deep under the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] where emergencies affecting Galactic City could be dealt with.
